leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply the align-self property to vertically position individual grid items within their cells.
Configure the justify-self property to horizontally align individual grid items within their cells.
Manipulate grid item alignment by overriding the parent container's align-items and justify-items settings.
Construct a grid layout where specific items use different self-alignment values than the default.
Initialize a CSS Grid container and selectively apply self-alignment to its child elements.
Update existing grid layouts by adjusting the align-self and justify-self properties on targeted items.
Integrate align-self and justify-self with other grid properties to achieve precise item placement.
